reviews.text: Excellent showroom with a fantastic range of modular kitchens and wardrobes. The staff guided us thoroughly through all the options without any pressure. Highly recommended for anyone planning their home interiors in Jaipur.
We got our modular kitchen done from Sumanglam and the quality is outstanding. The Nolte products are top-notch and the team was professional from design to delivery. Absolutely love the result.
Great variety of hardware and kitchen fittings under one roof. Good customer service and honest pricing. The Hettich hardware they stock is genuinely premium quality.

Visited the showroom for wardrobe fittings and was blown away by the display. You can actually open drawers, test the finish, and compare materials in person. That experience is priceless before making a big purchase.
Best place in Jaipur for modular kitchen hardware. The team is knowledgeable and helped us pick the right appliances for our layout. Installation was smooth and the after-service has been great.
Very impressive showroom spread across multiple floors. Got our Häfele fittings from here and they have been rock solid for 6 months now. The staff is patient and knows the products well.

Sumanglam has completely transformed how we think about our kitchen. From the initial consultation to the final installation, every step was handled with care. The showroom itself is worth a visit just for the inspiration.

Renovated our entire home with products from Sumanglam — kitchen, wardrobes, and bathroom hardware. The quality across everything is consistent and excellent. The team kept us updated throughout the project.
Good range of products from reputed brands. The showroom is spacious and well-organised. The consultation was helpful in understanding what would work best for our space and budget.

Five stars without hesitation. The Nolte kitchen they designed for us is still looking brand new two years on. Sumanglam is the only place I recommend to family and friends in Jaipur for home interiors.
